response.statement: Synthetic tenant response: I agree these are our lease terms. I broke the shelf during my tenancy and agree with the GBP 80 repair invoice. The hallway scuffs were already present at check-in, did not worsen, and are ordinary wear. I dispute the GBP 120 repainting deduction.
